scope: Read-only source/API design review, no runtime change and no solve

facts: It constructs a PathConstraint over active B-spline control variables and unchanged basis values.
PathConstraint forwards native AutoDiff through its wrapped constraint.
RemoveConstraint accepts Binding<Constraint> and returns removed count.

entry_points.scope: NTO_PAPER and each NTO_REFINED native round

feasible_design: Store all native collision Binding objects with exact collocation locations.
Ordinary solver uses original native constraint directly.
Only exact known BoxBoxGradient RuntimeError or SystemExit may initiate one internal recovery.
Persist first exception, elapsed seconds and full solver log before retry.
Remove exactly the stored collision bindings, assert each removal count equals one, and re-add existing guarded wrapper at identical locations.
Keep same MathematicalProgram, initial guess, objectives, limits, collision model and filters.
Recompute remaining wall deadline and native solver limit before retry; no fresh outer attempt or budget.
Unknown errors and retry errors propagate; guard/recovery errors never become feasible points.
NTO_REFINED retains its existing collision-refinement rounds and candidate validation.
required_regressions_before_adoption: Installed binding return type/removal count, variable order, bounds, and initial guess invariance.
Normal-input objective/gradient/path equivalence and no PyFunction invocation.
Exact known exception retries once with all constraints and bounded shared budget; unknown exception never retries.
First solver log and exception remain available after second solver invocation.
Native handling of nonfinite iterates must be checked; Python explicit normal-path guard would no longer execute before each native Eval.
Historical BoxBox fixtures plus actual failed development query remain necessary end-to-end checks.
caveats: Solver internal state cannot be resumed through current public Solve API; recovery restarts from preserved initial guess and counts prior work.
A rare recovery near the deadline can time out where always-on guarded evaluation would not.
No claim of native nonfinite-input equivalence until independently tested.
No runtime implementation made; currently frozen evaluation remains unchanged.
remaining_decision: Parent to decide adoption after measured normal-Eval overhead; runtime remains frozen and unchanged.
